write_rules: Never store passwords, tokens, private keys, OTP values, recovery codes, cookies, or authorization headers.
Store only DPAPI vault record identifiers in credential_ref fields.
Record stable claims as facts and time-bound checks as observations.
Do not silently replace conflicting facts; mark the old fact superseded or disputed and preserve provenance.
Record a productive infrastructure change only after verification, including rollback state.
Search prior incidents, changes, decisions, and runbooks before diagnosing a recurring problem.
Record a diagnosed problem as an incident and preserve its symptoms, root cause, remediation, prevention, and lifecycle events without secrets.
Reverify stale or low-confidence data before using it for a consequential change.
Update versioned inventory or runbooks when they are the authoritative source, then synchronize the database.
